exposure: reasons for bypassing (medical referral, search for higher quality care, reliance on family/social networks, affordable treatment costs)
outcome: proportion of women bypassing the nearest health facility
cohort: 763 women living in urban slums in Dakar who had undergone a caesarean section.
finding: Despite good geographical accessibility, 44.3% of women in Dakar's urban slums bypassed nearby health facilities offering caesarean sections, primarily due to medical referrals and the search for higher quality care.
